title: Structured logging execution root
description: Shared execution root for implementing structured `os.Logger` instrumentation across `CookbookApp` only, including namespace creation, targeted log insertion at the specified choke points, project regeneration, and final validation/handoff.
acceptance_criteria: All required logging work for this spec is represented by child beads with explicit dependencies.
Developer beads are scoped to focused, short implementation units by subsystem.
Exactly one shared tester bead, one shared documentation bead, and one shared review bead exist under this feature.
Shared tester and documentation beads depend on all developer beads.
Shared review depends on all developer beads plus the shared tester and documentation beads.
